'''Provost Marshal''' was the rank granted to [[Fideltin Rusk]] while he was in command of the [[Dead Man's Legion]], a unit of forcibly-conscripted criminals in service to the [[Republic Army]].<ref name="Fallen Empire">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>
